tickets.title: Freeze provider sources and cross-module contracts
tickets.deliverable: Source/contract decisions, focused module plan, credential exception and fixed acceptance catalog
tickets.expected_red: Planning ledger lacks a complete dependency and contract allocation; this planning ticket has no production TDD claim.
tickets.done_when: Plan checks pass and owner approval is recorded; no implementation claim

tickets.title: Owner-controlled API billing enrollment
tickets.deliverable: Enrollment HTTP and dashboard metadata/status controls, queued verification contract and local no-echo credential binding; provider verification is integrated in M7-T007
tickets.expected_red: Real account HTTP/browser lacks billing enrollment and binding status; verify no key can enter a request.
tickets.done_when: Real owner-created billing metadata and binding status work through HTTP/browser without key disclosure; queued verification remains explicitly unavailable until the provider collector is integrated

tickets.title: Implement the fixed M7 executable test and exit catalog
tickets.deliverable: Canonical technical/live/browser/exit commands and typed receipt
tickets.expected_red: Canonical M7 command is unavailable and cannot assess required evidence; implement executable checks before delivery claims.
tickets.done_when: Missing required evidence fails closed; no scope inferred from a passing partial lane

tickets.title: Exact budget values, resource pools and public ports
tickets.deliverable: Versioned exact input/view/query/commit contracts and domain rules
tickets.expected_red: Pure budget policy cannot represent distinct exact money/availability or prevent mixed-pool aggregation.
tickets.done_when: Float, currency, overlap and unknown-state checks pass after meaningful Red

tickets.title: Immutable budget persistence and additive migration
tickets.deliverable: v1_0730 companions, exact commit receipts and bounded queries
tickets.expected_red: Real migrated SQLite lacks signed cost/context tables and cannot retrieve fresh adapter facts exactly.
tickets.done_when: Fresh real Anthropic adapter output commits through the production M05 port and survives retry/reopen with exact lineage; full scheduler/parent manifest proof belongs to M7-T007

tickets.title: Anthropic administrative billing collector
tickets.deliverable: Admitted analytics usage/cost mapping, exact decimals, paged source coverage
tickets.expected_red: With valid real access, the production adapter cannot emit the required cost/usage batch; absent access is Blocked.
tickets.done_when: Real permitted reads reconciled with authoritative source within documented lag

tickets.title: Schedule and commit independent budget collections
tickets.deliverable: Bounded jobs, unique chunk receipts, parent completeness, safe failures/backoff
tickets.expected_red: Real scheduler cannot route/commit budget pages or expose incomplete collection without refreshing stale facts.
tickets.done_when: Real scheduled collection and recovery preserve other providers and dashboard

tickets.title: OpenAI administrative usage and costs collector
tickets.deliverable: Cost report and per-category usage adapters with capability metadata
tickets.expected_red: With real administrative access, OpenAI costs/categories cannot traverse the production budget adapter.
tickets.done_when: Real source values/dimensions reconcile; unavailable categories remain explicit

tickets.title: Ollama cloud usage with existing balance identity
tickets.deliverable: Official usage collector, self/team scope, shared pool links
tickets.expected_red: Real Ollama usage is absent and existing balance must remain one shared canonical pool.
tickets.done_when: Real usage reconciles without duplicating purchased or included balances

tickets.title: Budget HTTP boundary and generated client
tickets.deliverable: Six budget read operations and generated schemas/client; enrollment HTTP is owned by M7-T002
tickets.expected_red: Real HTTP returns missing routes instead of exact budget/history/forecast DTOs and bounded pages.
tickets.done_when: Real Uvicorn IAM, exact fields, pagination and no-collection GET checks pass

tickets.title: Account budget and history screens
tickets.deliverable: Separate budget section, details, breakdown/history chart and exact table
tickets.expected_red: The built account page lacks the API budget and history section exposed by the real API.
tickets.done_when: Real browser renders API values, actionable setup and truthful missing states

tickets.title: Compact API-budget Overview and accessibility
tickets.deliverable: Compact separate pool section using existing provider/org filters
tickets.expected_red: The built Overview lacks independently filtered API-budget rows and keyboard-readable state.
tickets.done_when: Responsive/keyboard and real DOM checks preserve quota, promotion and support UI

tickets.title: Budget forecasts, revisions and retained history
tickets.deliverable: Exact budget-specific forecast, lineage, revised buckets and retention
tickets.expected_red: Pure daily bucket policy produces absent/incorrect rate or real history query loses revision lineage.
tickets.done_when: No invented exhaustion; genuine history yields explainable result or insufficient inputs

tickets.title: Candidate-safe deployment and rollback
tickets.deliverable: Canonical selected-candidate activation, migration backup and recovery journal
tickets.expected_red: Existing fixed M6 updater refuses the M7 candidate; verify candidate/backup boundaries before transition.
tickets.done_when: Real sealed M7 candidate can activate/recover with schema and service verification

tickets.title: Reconcile all configured sources and installed browser
tickets.deliverable: Same-scope/time source comparisons, real built UI, history and continuity report
tickets.expected_red: The real candidate cannot yet supply a complete source-to-API-to-DOM reconciliation; missing accounts are Blocked.
tickets.done_when: Required three-provider lanes pass; natural-state limitations remain separately explicit
tickets.verification: python3 tools/automation/run.py AUTO-M7-LIVE; python3 tools/automation/run.py AUTO-M7-BROWSER

tickets.title: Bounded review, publish current code and close M7
tickets.deliverable: Sanitized final receipt, current GitHub revision, runbook and acceptance record
tickets.expected_red: Required technical/live evidence is absent; publication and acceptance remain Not Run until demonstrated.
tickets.done_when: Gate passes against deployed revision; remote verified; owner accepts demonstrated scope
